d:
A devastating high-speed train collision in central Spain has killed at least 68 people and injured around 100, with authorities warning that the death toll could rise. The crash occurred in the province of Toledo when one train slammed into the rear of another that had stopped, derailing two carriages. The accident involved trains operated by Spain’s state-owned RENFE and private rail company IRYO, carrying hundreds of passengers.
Produced & Edited By Ankit Kumar
